# Iron Bull Handyman Services
> Handyman services in Keizer, Oregon and the Willamette Valley. Oregon CCB #259600. (503) 984-4446.

## Services
- [Drywall Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/drywall-repair/): patching holes, cracks, water damage, and texture matching. $150–$600 for most single-room repairs
- [Door Repair & Installation](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/door-repair-installation/): sticking doors, new interior and exterior doors, hardware, weatherstripping. $120–$350 adjustments · $400–$900 installed interior door
- [Fence Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/fence-repair/): leaning posts, broken rails, gate sag, board replacement. $200–$500 per post · $35–$70 per panel section
- [Deck Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/deck-repair/): soft boards, loose railings, stairs, sealing. $300–$1,500 depending on framing
- [Interior Painting](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/interior-painting/): single rooms, trim, ceilings, touch-ups after repairs. $250–$700 per room
- [Gutter Cleaning & Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/gutter-cleaning/): clearing, resealing, downspout and pitch correction. $150–$300 single story · $250–$450 two story
- [Light Fixtures & Ceiling Fans](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/light-fixture-installation/): replacing fixtures, ceiling fans, vanity lights, exterior lighting. $120–$280 per fixture · $180–$400 ceiling fan
- [Faucet & Toilet Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/faucet-toilet-repair/): leaking faucets, running toilets, replacements, shutoff valves. $120–$250 repair · $250–$500 fixture replacement
- [Tile & Flooring Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/tile-flooring-repair/): cracked tile, loose planks, transitions, subfloor patches. $200–$800
- [Trim & Molding](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/trim-molding/): baseboard, casing, crown, shoe, repairs after flooring work. $4–$9 per linear foot installed
- [Shelving & Storage](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/shelving-storage/): closet systems, garage shelving, floating shelves, pantry. $150–$600
- [TV Mounting](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/tv-mounting/): wall mounts, cable concealment, soundbar brackets. $120–$300
- [Pressure Washing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/pressure-washing/): driveways, siding, decks, walkways, moss removal. $200–$500
- [Window & Screen Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iron-bull-handyman-services-llc/services/window-screen-repair/): screen rescreening, sash cords, failed seals, hardware. $60–$150 per screen · $250–$600 sash repair
